import subprocess, os
cmd=['claude','-p','只回复 OK，不要调用任何工具。','--output-format','json']
try:
    p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
    print('exit_code:',p.returncode)
    print('stdout:',p.stdout[:5000])
    print('stderr:',p.stderr[:5000])
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
    print('TIMEOUT after 120s')
    print('stdout:',(e.stdout or b'')[:2000] if isinstance(e.stdout,bytes) else (e.stdout or '')[:2000])
    print('stderr:',(e.stderr or b'')[:2000] if isinstance(e.stderr,bytes) else (e.stderr or '')[:2000])
